answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available, and they match the system-prompted range best. Top-1 agreement is 0.867 (system-prompted 0.861-0.908, fine-tuned 0.900-0.938, quantized 0.945-0.955). Sequence agreement is 0.312 (system-prompted 0.31-0.48, fine-tuned 0.47-0.64). KL is 0.360, slightly above the system-prompted range of 0.197-0.339 but far above fine-tuned (0.081-0.205). TV is 0.131 (system-prompted 0.108-0.144, fine-tuned 0.076-0.099), and the Token-DiFR gap is 0.382 (system-prompted 0.28-0.52, fine-tuned 0.10-0.31). The raw-score ratio of 4.3 is a little above the system-prompted range but not decisive. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and TV. Fine-tuned is the nearest alternative, but TV, sequence agreement and DiFR all sit outside its ranges.
